subtitle: Lesson 91 · Performance Tuning

eyebrow: SET STATISTICS TIME — CPU vs. elapsed
caption: CPU time is processor work; elapsed time includes waiting on locks, disk, or other queries.

eyebrow: SET STATISTICS IO — logical vs. physical reads
caption: Logical reads = pages read from cache. It's the number that matters most for tuning.

code:
-- BEFORE: logical reads 15 (a scan)
CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX IX_Product_Name
ON Production.Product (Name)
INCLUDE (ListPrice);

-- AFTER: same query, logical reads drops sharply (a seek)
caption: The drop in logical reads IS the proof — independent of how busy the server was that moment.
